meta.name: Power Rangers S.P.D.
meta.description: When the Earth is threatened by the evil Troobian empire, the SPD (Space Patrol Delta) police force recruits a team of Power Rangers to help defend the planet.

videos.name: Beginnings (1)
videos.overview: Two street kids are pursued by the S.P.D., a space patrol from the future whose job it is to protect Earth from evil aliens.
videos.description: Two street kids are pursued by the S.P.D., a space patrol from the future whose job it is to protect Earth from evil aliens.
